records.body:
=== Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. If still tied, they share the win (a draw). If exactly one player is alive, that player wins. If no player is alive, nobody wins and the game is a draw.

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. === Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. [user]
=== Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. If still tied, they share the win (a draw). If exactly one player is alive, that player wins. If no player is alive, nobody wins and the game is a draw.

5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.

Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. === Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. If still tied, they share the win (a draw). If exactly one player is alive, that player wins. If no player is alive, nobody wins and the game is a draw.

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.

9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. === Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. 2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.

=== Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. 3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.

Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. === Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. 2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.

=== Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. === Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. If still tied, they share the win (a draw). If exactly one player is alive, that player wins. If no player is alive, nobody wins and the game is a draw.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.

[user]
=== Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. If still tied, they share the win (a draw). If exactly one player is alive, that player wins. If no player is alive, nobody wins and the game is a draw.

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.

Actions you may be asked for:

  aim_the_gun  answer with one of the options you are given

  stand_or_duck answer with one of: Stand, Duck

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.
                   Do not reply. Wait to be asked.
  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,

  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. === Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. [user]
=== Cash and Guns: Standoff ===

Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. If still tied, they share the win (a draw). If exactly one player is alive, that player wins. If no player is alive, nobody wins and the game is a draw.

records.system:
You are reviewing a game that has finished. You were not a player. You are shown everything: the messages the table was told, every move, and each player's private thinking at every move, which no other player ever saw. Each move carries the notes its game asked for, under their own names. The usual ones are:

  plan     what they meant to do over the coming turns
  reason   why they made that move
  predict  what they expected their opponents to do
  adjust   how they changed their own strategy because of that

Write two things.

First, a summary of the whole game as it unfolded: the turning points, the moves that decided it, and how it ended. Concrete: name seats, rounds and numbers.

Second, a review of each player. Judge their play, not their luck. For each one, compare their predictions with what their opponents were actually thinking and actually did: were they right, and did they see it in time? Did their adjustments follow from their predictions, and did their moves follow from their reasons? Point out their best and worst moves. Then score their play from 1 to 10, where 1 is aimless or self-defeating and 10 is sharp, well read and well executed. A player can lose and still score well, or win and score badly.

A player who gave no reasons, predictions or adjustments is judged on their moves alone; say that their thinking was not recorded.

Refer to each player by seat, and as "they".

THE GAME
Each player starts with 0 cash, 0 wounds and a private hand of 8 bullet cards: 3 Bang and 5 Click. Only you know which cards remain in your hand. The game lasts 8 rounds.

EACH ROUND:
1. LOOT. A whole number from 6 to 14 is drawn at random. That number, in thousands of dollars (1000 dollars each), is this round's pot. It is announced to everyone.
2. TALK. Every living player writes 1 short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Nothing said is binding.
3. AIM. At the same time, every living player secretly chooses a target, which is any other living player, and one bullet card from their hand, Bang or Click, which must be a card they still hold. You are only offered card types still in your hand.
4. GUNS SHOWN. Everyone's target is announced publicly. Bullets stay hidden.
5. STAND OR DUCK. At the same time, every living player chooses Stand or Duck. The choices are then announced.
6. FIRE. Each player's chosen bullet is removed from their hand whatever happens. A bullet is FIRED only if its shooter Stood and its target Stood; fired bullets are revealed publicly. A shooter who Ducked, or whose target Ducked, discards the bullet face down: its type is never revealed and it causes no wound. Each fired Bang gives its target 1 wound; a player hit by several Bangs takes several wounds. A fired Click does nothing. All shots happen at once, so a player who is wounded still fires their own bullet.
7. ELIMINATION. A player with 3 or more wounds is eliminated. They keep their cash for the record but cannot win, and they take no further part.
8. SPLIT. The SHARERS are the players who Stood, were not wounded this round, and were not eliminated. Each sharer gains the pot divided equally among them, which may be fractional. If there are no sharers, the pot is lost. Players who Ducked or were wounded this round gain nothing.
9. END CHECK. If only one player is alive, the game ends. If no player is alive, the game ends in a draw. Otherwise, after round 8, the game ends.

Revealed bullets are public; discarded bullets are not, so a player's remaining Bang count can be inferred only from what was revealed.

WINNING: Only players still alive at the end can win. The living player with the highest cash wins. If living players are tied on cash, the one among them with the most wounds wins. If still tied, they share the win (a draw). If exactly one player is alive, that player wins. If no player is alive, nobody wins and the game is a draw.
